seoTitle: Add SMA and EMA Moving Averages in TradingView
metaDescription: Learn how to add simple and exponential moving averages to a TradingView chart and customize their color and thickness for clarity.
intro: Moving averages are one of the most common tools traders add to a TradingView chart, and understanding the difference between SMA and EMA can help you choose the right one for your strategy. This guide covers adding both indicators and customizing their appearance.

steps.heading: Open the indicators panel
steps.body: Click the indicators button at the top of your chart to search the list of available TradingView indicators.

steps.heading: Add the Simple Moving Average
steps.body: Search for SMA and add it to your chart, where it appears as a line showing the average of past periods for a smoother trend view.

steps.heading: Add the Exponential Moving Average
steps.body: Search for EMA and add it alongside the SMA, since it weights recent prices more heavily and reacts faster to price changes.

steps.heading: Customize the SMA settings
steps.body: Adjust the period, color, and line thickness of your SMA to make it easier to distinguish on the chart.

steps.heading: Customize the EMA settings
steps.body: Repeat the process for the EMA, choosing a contrasting color and thickness so both lines are easy to tell apart.

steps.heading: Save your changes
steps.body: Click OK after each customization to apply your settings to the chart.

faq.question: What's the difference between SMA and EMA?
faq.answer: SMA calculates a straightforward average of past prices for a smoother trend line, while EMA weights recent prices more heavily, making it more responsive to short-term changes.

faq.question: Can I add both SMA and EMA to the same chart?
faq.answer: Yes, you can add both indicators at once and customize their colors to tell them apart easily.

faq.question: Which moving average is better for short-term trading?
faq.answer: EMA tends to be more responsive to recent price changes, which many short-term traders prefer.

faq.question: How do I change the moving average period?
faq.answer: You can adjust the period in the indicator's settings after adding it to your chart.

faq.question: Can I customize the color of each moving average?
faq.answer: Yes, both SMA and EMA settings let you choose a color and line thickness for better visibility.
